ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 high-intensity white to low-intensity black/gray across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white central fields on both lobes; heavy low-intensity black mottling and streaking concentrated along the leading edges, the center-base near the peduncle, and the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree pixel angle at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern consisting of approximately 12-15 distinct jagged peaks and valleys per lobe along the trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex outward curve on both lobes, sweeping upward toward distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, high-contrast dark pixel clusters corresponding to dense barnacle colonies on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes; scattered dark spots present on the central white fields.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed; notably several vertical and diagonal lines on the left lobe and shorter horizontal scratches on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across both lobes; significant barnacle encrustation on the fluke tips causing irregular geometric distortions.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme tips of both lobes exhibit bulbous, high-contrast texture due to concentrated parasitic/epibiotic growth.
